prompt:
Build an ultra-realistic, fully functional 3D hydraulic excavator simulator in a single index.html file using Three.js.

Procedurally model every component, including the tracks, cabin, boom, arm, bucket, hydraulic cylinders, hoses, and mechanical linkages.

The excavator must actually excavate terrain, collect soil into its bucket, transport it, and dump it elsewhere. Terrain deformation, soil volume conservation, hydraulic piston movement, joint constraints, and bucket collisions must be physically consistent.

Include highly detailed geometry, realistic materials, dynamic shadows, reflections, dust particles, and cinematic lighting.

Automatically start the simulation immediately on page load. Continuously repeat the complete excavation cycle: digging, scooping, lifting, rotating, dumping, and returning to the starting position.

The entire simulation must loop seamlessly and indefinitely, without visible resets, abrupt transitions, pauses, or user interaction. Keep the terrain and soil physically consistent across repeated cycles.

Use a cinematic camera angle that clearly captures the entire excavation process. Minimize UI elements and maximize the visual presentation.

Do not fake the excavation using predetermined visual effects. Do not use external models, images, or textures. Everything must be generated through code.

Make it look and behave like a premium next-generation engineering simulator, with the visual fidelity of an AAA video game.

Complete everything in one shot. Do not ask questions.
